reason: Routes cross a cliff smoothed out by the routing elevation model.
routing_model: Mapzen/AWS Terrarium; z13 routing grid, z15 cross-check
validation_model: Kartverket NHM DTM, EPSG:25832, 1 m cells
validation_method: Central-difference terrain slope from the 1 m DTM; sample original route at approximately 0.5 m intervals within 500 m of the reported location. Maximum is a local raster-cell estimate, not a surveyed cliff angle.
remaining_routes: At withdrawal, the remaining Terrarium routes were not validated against the 1 m terrain model. Current native-data replacements are described in kartverket-analysis.json.
